findings.summary: Context is pushed/popped via `with ctx:` on every chunk and torn down before the body starts, so every teardown runs N+2 times and breaks resources like DB connections and request files
New test assertion passes with or without the fix, so it doesn't demonstrate the change as the PR template requires
No CHANGES.rst entry or versionchanged note
AI policy likely applies; body carries marks of tool output (local harness path, template sections)

why: Finding 1 states that the context is pushed and popped on every chunk with full teardown each time, which is the maintainer's inefficiency reason in substance; finding 4 also raises the AI policy, though hedged.
